title: wireThemeControl + resolveBootTheme + THEME_STORAGE_KEY: boot precedence, non-embed persistence, embed strip
description: Baz 2026-10-04 (w-2026-10-04-dave-001), ADR-4137: `wireThemeControl()` wires the three Light|Dark|Auto buttons and, under embed, removes the `[data-rcf-theme-control]` element from the DOM entirely instead of merely hiding it. `resolveBootTheme(query)` picks the effective theme in the pinned precedence (`?theme=` wins; then stored value under `localStorage['rcf-view:v1:theme']` in non-embed mode; then `auto`). `readStoredTheme()` and `writeStoredTheme(v)` check `isEmbedActive()` at the storage boundary and refuse the read/write under embed so the key is zero-touched. The `message` listener still applies live `rcf-view-theme` postMessages in both modes and never writes the stored key. `reflectThemeChoice(mode)` keeps `aria-pressed` in sync across live swaps.
